label: Information Architecture
description: Design content structures, navigation systems, and labelling strategies for websites, apps, and intranets. Includes card sort analysis and tree testing design.

modelTier.notes: Sonnet for most IA work. Opus for large-scale enterprise systems with complex content hierarchies.

guidedInputs.label: Site / App Context
guidedInputs.description: What is this product? Who uses it? What are they trying to accomplish?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Insurance company intranet — 2,000 staff across claims, underwriting, and compliance. Users need to find policies, forms, HR tools, and IT support.

guidedInputs.label: Content Types to Organise
guidedInputs.description: What types of content or features need to be structured?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. 450 policy documents, 60 forms, 12 tools/calculators, news/announcements, staff directory, training resources

guidedInputs.label: Primary User Tasks
guidedInputs.description: What are the most common tasks users need to accomplish?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Find and download the claims handling procedure. Submit a holiday request. Access the IT helpdesk.

guidedInputs.label: Primary IA Problem
guidedInputs.description: What is the main IA challenge to solve?
